ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white central pixels with low-intensity dark boundaries; approximate 90:10 white-to-black distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the interior surface; low-intensity dark pixel bands mapped along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the central axis; estimated internal angle of 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth serrations detected as dark pixel peaks along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep trajectory extending from the median notch vertex toward the terminal tips of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, irregular pixel masses concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlight at the insertion point of the fluke and peduncle (central lower region).
